admission.justification: The no-fold regression test and the untouched ambient writer pin preservation at the event source; the projection folds nothing from single-event tokens. Admission claims guarded_by_test only: the invariant is proved by named regression tests rather than multi-file realizations.

applicability: The single-event tokens writer and every projection fold: events keep their tokens and no fold sums them.
conditions: The ambient writer records tokens per tool answer as before.
exclusions: Computed aggregates over events, which no longer exist.
statement: The tokens of a single event stay as a fact of its event; a row of the Event River may show them as the size of that one answer.
